set.body:
Objective
Release ravel-core 1.0 only after ownership, shape, static-rank, numerical, performance, consumer, artifact, and publication contracts are executable and green.

Release scope
- ravel-core is the sole intended stable 1.0 artifact family.
- ravel-laws, ravel-packed, and ravel-stencil must either be excluded from the core 1.0 publication or released on explicitly separate experimental version lines.
- The tag workflow must publish exactly the artifacts verified by the authoritative release gate.

Exit criteria
- No known borrowed-provenance or mutable-transfer leak remains.
- Every core shape, stride, offset, narrow endpoint, and storage-size transformation is checked.
- The fixed-rank indexing and transpose policy is resolved before the compatibility baseline.
- Required JVM, Node, Chromium, representation, NumPy parity, documentation, formatting, artifact, and fresh-consumer gates pass from one candidate commit.
- At least Gale and one additional substantial JVM or Scala.js consumer resolve local published artifacts without internal access.
- The release candidate process completes with blocker-only changes after RC1.
- The published 1.0 artifact becomes the MiMa baseline immediately.

Non-goals
Packed, stencil, laws-conformance, speculative dtypes, SIMD, and parallel execution do not enter core 1.0 merely because they share this repository.
set.title: EPIC: Release ravel-core 1.0 with explicit module boundaries
